findings: Actual 1994 oil pan Fig34 pixels inspected: 25 screw-and-washer assemblies, 5/16-18 x .87 in. Head/washer dimensions and captive construction remain current model conventions.
Exact-year timing-cover removal names attaching screws and calls for a replacement crankshaft seal; no cover screw size/length/mapping or separate cover washers supplied.
Exact-year torque table names timing-cover attaching bolts, but torque does not establish bolt dimensions. No torque is inferred for the proposed geometry.
Exact-year front-cover seal parts entry lists E6DZ6700A; no dimensions or lip-track datum provided. This part number is recorded, not used to resize the current illustrative seal.
Current manifest has no main-cover mounting fastener definitions or occurrences. Seven source-supported holes are retained as unresolved mounting axes.
Five relocated pan screw/washer pairs reuse existing physical definitions and retain indices10,20,21,22,23. Twenty other pairs remain unchanged.
bounded_search_limits: Public exact-year dealer parts page was not accessible through search tool.
1987 Bronco and mixed-engine catalog results include differing cover bolts/studs. Those are unverified leads and are not transferred to 1994 4.9 hardware.
thread_classification: Male nominal 5/16-18 x22.098mm is source supported; male profile/head and female conjugate geometry are estimated teaching geometry. No factory thread class/preload/material-strength assertion.
